title: Healthy server: say so, invent nothing
description: A normal, quiet home AI/media server: 33 containers up, disks under 62 %, a few harmless kernel warnings and two image updates (INFO only). The right report is health ok with a high score and no problems. This is the false-alarm test: small models tend to find 'issues' in a healthy digest (restart counts, image updates, kernel noise). A model that cries wolf here would spam the owner every five minutes.

judge.rubric: Overview says the server is healthy. Findings is empty or only mentions the two image updates as a note. Resources gives CPU ~11 %, memory ~35 %, the RTX 4090 and the disks correctly. No invented problems, no alarmist tone, Recommendations is 'None' or trivial.
